risk_description: The press-in force of the counterbalance shaft’s bearing shells may not have met the specifications, which could cause the counterbalance shaft to become loose. As a result, the engine could be damaged and locked in motion, increasing the risk of an accident.
model_types: Types: G3X, G5X, 7L, G3L, G3K, G4Z, G5L, G5K, G6GT
